FACT_ID: sec12-F01 | anchor: A01
Over three hundred thousand state crashes yearly strike even careful lawful drivers through surprises and others mistakes, so crash parties must act responsibly on scene and obey reporting law, with flares and first-aid kits from department or auto stores riding aboard. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]

FACT_ID: sec12-F02 | anchor: A01
Every crash demands a stop whatever the damage, flight from property-only scenes counts as a traffic violation, and flight from fatal or injury scenes counts as criminal. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]

FACT_ID: sec12-F03 | anchor: A01
Property-only crashes still force exchanges of name address license registration and insurance including policy number and effective date with fellow drivers and scene police, plus insurance cards shown on demand. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]

FACT_ID: sec12-F04 | anchor: A01
Harm to parked vehicles non-vehicle property or domestic animals obliges finding owners or notifying police. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]

FACT_ID: sec12-F05 | anchor: A01
Any injury or death summons police at once with ambulance or rescue confirmed en route. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]

FACT_ID: sec12-F06 | anchor: A01
Vehicles clear the roadway when able while reflectors or flares guard scenes against leaking fuel and live traffic for everybody present. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]

FACT_ID: sec12-F07 | anchor: A01
Uninvolved drivers roll past unless aid lags, eyes on driving and officer orders. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]

FACT_ID: sec12-F08 | anchor: A01
Injured people stay put short of fire or mortal peril, and forced moves brace backs and necks straight with arms beneath torsos and upper arms cradling necks while gripped clothes drag victims head-first clear. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]

FACT_ID: sec12-F09 | anchor: A01
Downed wires repel approach, and wire-touched vehicles hold occupants inside until rescuers come. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]

FACT_ID: sec12-F10 | anchor: A01
Fatal injury or one-thousand-dollar-plus single-victim property crashes demand motor-vehicle reports on crash forms stocked at offices agents and the agency website. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]

FACT_ID: sec12-F11 | anchor: A01
Insurer notice never satisfies law since motor-vehicle filings land within ten days under misdemeanor peril suspending or revoking driver and owner credentials, and hurt drivers cede filing to passengers or owners. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=77]
